expectedFindings.summary: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is a server-only secret returned in the API response — any browser or unauthenticated caller receives it, bypassing Row Level Security and gaining unrestricted read/write access to every Supabase table
GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET is returned in the response — any caller can use it to forge valid HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures, bypassing all webhook authentication
